texts.title: Texts
texts.description: One piece of text per line. Each line becomes one audio clip.
prefill: Welcome to the text to speech actor. Every line of this list becomes one audio clip.
The second line is a separate clip, made by the same voice in the same run.

text.title: Single text
text.description: Used only when the texts list is empty.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Neural voice baked into the image.

format.title: Audio format
format.description: wav is uncompressed, mp3 is smaller. Both are made inside the image.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: 1.0 is the voice's natural speed, 0.5 is twice as slow, 2.0 twice as fast.

maxClips.title: Max clips
maxClips.description: Lines past this limit are refused and free.

maxCharactersPerLine.title: Max characters per line
maxCharactersPerLine.description: A longer line is refused before anything is synthesised, and it is free.
